Synopsis:
Polymarket's new global head of investigations and intelligence outlines the company's market integrity controls ahead of the 2026 US midterm elections. The article covers Polymarket's compliance posture re: its 2022 CFTC settlement (barring US users), its law enforcement referral track record, and its plans to publicly document its surveillance and blockchain analytics capabilities. Regulatory and political pressure from US lawmakers remains elevated, with concerns around insider trading, election integrity, and national security.
